preset.title: Presets
preset.settings-color-auto: Take it from the fixture color
preset.steps-beats-hint: The steps follow the tempo they are played at. Their times are written down at {{bpm}} BPM.
preset.settings-fan-order-hint: The order fans, gradients and fanned effects follow. On the stage, fixtures at the same place get the same value.
preset.settings-pattern-hint: For the chases and the fans in the order of the preset: the fixtures of a group take the same place, every other wing runs the other way round (from the middle out), every N repeats the places (every other fixture in another color).

fixture.no-fixtures: Add new fixtures to the project
fixture.pixel-group: {{count}} pixels of the fixture library's group
fixture.pixels-as-rows: Pixels as rows, to change the order they are chased in
fixture.no-fixtures-selected: Select at least one fixture for this preset
fixture.no-capabilities-available: There are no capabilities available for the selected fixtures. Please use the channels-tab.
fixture.setting-color-dimmers-at-full: A color alone lights a color fixture
fixture.setting-color-dimmers-at-full-hint: The dimmers of fixtures lighting only in colors start at full. Fixtures with a color wheel or without colors keep their dimmers off.
fixture.channel-effect-driven: An effect drives this channel and overrides the value shown here
fixture.model-specific-hint: What you set on these channels only plays on this model of fixture. The dimmer, the colors, the strobe, the zoom, the focus, the iris and the frost of the capabilities play on every model, so the show plays on other fixtures as well.
fixture.capability-pan-tilt-pad-hint: Drag to point the moving heads: across for the pan, up and down for the tilt. The arrow keys move a degree (ten with Shift), a double click centres them.
fixture.capability-pan-tilt-spread-hint: Spreads the heads evenly over this many degrees, from the first to the last.
fixture.capability-pan-tilt-aim-hint: Click a spot in the 3D preview: every head points at it from wherever it hangs, whatever its model.
fixture.capability-gobo-pattern-pick: Match the gobo with a pattern
fixture.fan-hint: Fans the value out over the fixtures of the preset, in the fan order of the preset settings
fixture.fan-bars-hint: What each fixture gets, in the order of the fan
fixture.capability-color-gradient-hint: Spans a gradient of colors over the fixtures of the preset
fixture.capability-color-gradient-order: From the first to the last fixture, in the fan order of the preset settings. Fixtures with a color wheel take the closest color.
fixture.strobe-effect-hint: What the strobe flashes in. Fixtures without the effect flash in the closest one they have, in the end as a plain strobe.
fixture.capability-color-white: White and amber on their LEDs
fixture.capability-color-white-hint: Fixtures with white or amber LEDs besides red, green and blue light those parts of the color with them (for the whole preset). The color temperature plays on warm and cold white LEDs, or as a color, on fixtures without a channel for it.
fixture.capability-gobos-hint: Picks the gobo on the gobo wheel of every model showing it (matched to it in the wheel of each model, or named the same). Models without it keep theirs.
fixture.capability-wheel-rotation-off: Leave the rotation to the rest of the preset
fixture.capability-maintenance-hint: Asked for as long as the preset plays, e.g. at the start of the show.

fixture-pool.patch-in-a-row-full: The fixtures do not fit into the universe from there on.
fixture-pool.identify: Identify: let the fixture blink at full white
fixture-pool.model-specific: The presets set {{count}} values only this model plays.
fixture-pool.add-fixture: Add a fixture of this profile
fixture-pool.reset-hint: Asks the fixture on stage to reset itself, e.g. a moving head which lost its position
fixture-pool.lamp-on-hint: Switches the lamp of the fixture on stage on

dmx.title: DMX channels
dmx.show-unpatched: Show the channels no fixture is patched to
dmx.release: Let go of the fader: the channel sends what the presets put on it again
dmx.hint: The value sent on each channel, after the master dimmer. A fader holds its channel at its value, over what the presets put on it, until it is let go. Closing this page lets go of all faders.
dmx.no-universe: There is no universe yet. Add one in the fixture pool.
dmx.no-fixtures: No fixture is patched to this universe yet.

gradient.hint: Click the bar to add a color, drag a color down off it to remove it.

effect.pixel-blend-replace: Replace the color of the preset
effect.pixel-blend-mask: Mask the color of the preset
effect.pixel-blend-add: Add to the color of the preset
effect.pixel-image-failed: The image could not be read.
effect.pixel-audio-source-composition: Follows the audio of the composition
effect.pixel-audio-buses-preview: Here, the preview follows the audio file of the composition. Rocket Show follows the buses picked.
effect.pixel-audio-hint: The designer follows the audio while the timeline plays it, a beat otherwise. Rocket Show follows the audio it plays.
effect.pixel-dimmed-to-zero: The preset sets the dimmer to 0: the effect does not light the fixtures with a dimmer.
effect.pixel-palette-follows-preset: The shades of the color of the preset follow it. Pick a palette to edit its colors.
effect.curve-length-beats-hint: In beats, the period follows the tempo of the composition, so the curve stays in sync with the music.
effect.curve-run-hint: A chase starts every fixture on its own, so all of them run the curve completely.
effect.curve-duty-hint: The part of the period the curve is on. The curve keeps its shape: narrower, it rests at the bottom for the rest of the period, wider, at the top. In a chase, it is the part of the fixtures that are on at the same time: 10 % lights one fixture out of ten.
effect.curve-chase-group-hint: How many fixtures share the same chase step. 1 chases every fixture on its own, 2 moves them in pairs.
effect.delete-warning: Do you really want to delete this effect?
effect.curve-fan-hint: How far the effect moves each fixture by its place in the fan of the preset. Ends opposite: the first and the last the most, to opposite sides, the middle stays (a line opens and closes a fan). Ends alike: the first and the last the most, the same way. From the first: the first stays, the last moves the most.
effect.pixel-still-hint: The pattern stands where its phase and the chase put it, e.g. a gradient of the flow over the stage
effect.curve-pan-tilt-degrees-hint: Turns every model by the same degrees, instead of each over a share of its range.

timeline.warning-delete-composition: Do you really want to delete this composition? This action cannot be undone.
timeline.warning-delete-track: Do you really want to remove this track together with the scenes played on it?

intro.step-start: This two-minute-introduction will teach you the most basic functionalities of the Rocket Show Designer. 🏆 You can always skip by closing this window on the top right.
intro.step-preview: You can see a 3D-preview of your show here. This is a useful guidance, but it looks much better in reality, of course! If you're working on a Rocket Show device, you're able to activate a realtime preview for the connected devices in the settings.
intro.step-fixtures: Add new fixtures in the fixture pool (cogwheel upper right or key 'P') und and place them on the DMX universe. Continue, by selecting the fixtures you want to use in the current preset. But what's a preset? 🧐
intro.step-presets: A preset assigns properties and effects to a group of fixtures. There might be a preset to let all moving heads in the front row shine red.
intro.step-capabilities: The preset contains capabilities (e.g. a dimmer value or a color). But you can also edit the fixture channels manually or even add effects. 🎉
intro.step-scenes: One scene contains one or more presets. This allows for complex combinations you can easily use on different places. Higher placed presets overwrite properties from lower placed ones.
intro.step-timeline: You can place scenes on the timeline and play them in sync with an audio file. ⏱ Such a file equals a composition on the Rocket Show device. Your lighting show will be played automatically with your composition, if the names match.
intro.step-finish: About time you're gonna try it out by yourself! Share your shows with your friends and see, what they think about it. 👫
intro.ai: No time for the tour? Add your fixtures, and let AI design the presets and scenes for them, from your music and your mood.

hardware-promo.universes-hint: These universes aren't connected to anything yet. With real hardware, Rocket Show sends them out as real DMX.
hardware-promo.dmx-hint: This patch isn't controlling any lights yet. With real hardware, Rocket Show turns it into real DMX output.
hardware-promo.composition-hint: On Rocket Show with real hardware, this composition plays your audio and your lighting show together, fully automatically.
hardware-promo.share-hint: Want to see this on real fixtures? With real hardware, Rocket Show plays your shows over DMX.
hardware-promo.export-text: You just exported a complete lighting show. With real hardware, Rocket Show plays it back on your fixtures, in sync with your music.
hardware-promo.intro-finish: And when you want to see it on real fixtures: with real hardware, Rocket Show plays your shows over DMX.
hardware-promo.bar-title: Ready to bring your show to reality?
hardware-promo.bar-text: Everything you design here runs on Rocket Show with real hardware – real DMX output, in sync with your music.

ai.title: Design with AI
ai.unavailable: The AI looks aren't available on this server.
ai.no-fixtures: Add fixtures to the fixture pool first: the AI designs the looks for them.
ai.prompt: What should the show look like?
ai.prompt-placeholder: e.g. A synthwave ballad in pink and teal, building up to a big chorus
ai.output-song-hint: A scene for each part of a song (intro, verse, chorus, …), a blackout and a hit.
ai.output-set-hint: 12 to 20 scenes from calm to full on to play a show by hand, with hits, a blackout and a scene for between the songs.
ai.strobe-hint: Only in short hits, never faster than 3 flashes a second: flashing light can trigger seizures in people sensitive to it.
ai.groups: The AI designs for these fixtures
ai.designing: The AI is designing your looks…
ai.designing-hint: This takes up to a minute or two.
ai.ask-placeholder-scene: e.g. Slower, more blue, no strobe
ai.ask-placeholder-all: e.g. Warmer, and less movement in the verse
ai.ask-placeholder-add: e.g. A calm scene to talk between songs (optional)
ai.ask-hint-scene: Changes only “{{name}}”, the scene on the stage. The others stay as they are.
ai.ask-hint-all: Changes all scenes as you say.
ai.ask-hint-add: Adds one scene that fits the others. Without a description, the AI adds one they still miss.
ai.working-scene: The AI is changing this scene…
ai.working-add: The AI is designing one more scene…

fixture-ai.title: Create profile with AI
fixture-ai.unavailable: Profiles made by the AI aren't available here.
fixture-ai.intro: Name the fixture and give its manual. The library is searched first: a profile it already has costs nothing.
fixture-ai.improve-intro: The AI reads the manual of {{name}} ({{created}}) again and makes a new version of it, as you say.
fixture-ai.instruction-placeholder: e.g. channel 6 is the strobe, or the 12-channel mode is missing
fixture-ai.source-manual-hint: The manual of the fixture as a PDF, with its DMX chart.
fixture-ai.source-link-hint: The address of the manual of the fixture on the web.
fixture-ai.source-search-hint: The AI searches the web for the manual of the fixture. Without one, it makes no profile.
fixture-ai.mode-hint: Only the mode you need: fewer modes, fewer mistakes.
fixture-ai.found: The library has this fixture already. Take a version at once, it costs nothing:
fixture-ai.found-generate: Is a mode missing or wrong? Have the AI improve a version, or create a new profile.
fixture-ai.not-found: The library has no profile of this fixture yet. The AI can create one from the manual.
fixture-ai.generating: The AI reads the manual and writes the profile...
fixture-ai.generating-hint: This takes a few minutes. Please keep this dialog open.
fixture-ai.review-intro: Check each channel against the manual before you use the profile in a show. Where a row is "not verified", its quote was not found on the page it names.
fixture-ai.uncertain: What the AI wasn't sure about:
fixture-ai.manual-too-large: The manual is too large ({{size}} MB, at most {{max}} MB). Please upload only the pages with the DMX chart.

error.ai-manual-too-long: The manual is too long for the AI ({{inputTokens}} tokens, at most {{maxInputTokens}}). Please upload only the pages with the DMX chart.
error.ai-manual-too-large: The manual is too large to be uploaded. Please upload only the pages with the DMX chart.
error.ai-invalid-profile: The AI could not make a valid profile from this manual. What was still wrong:
error.ai-unavailable: Profiles made by the AI aren't available here.
error.ai-user-limit-reached: You've used all your profiles for today. Please try again tomorrow.
error.ai-limit-reached: The profiles of the AI are used up for today. Please try again tomorrow.
error.ai-no-manual: The AI found no manual of this fixture. Please upload it, or give a link to it.
error.ai-incomplete: The answer of the AI got too long. Please ask for one mode only.
